svg.title: From commit to release
svg.desc: Flow chart with 10 steps and 11 connections in 3 lanes: Development, Continuous integration and Operations. Main path: Commit pushed → Code review → Build → Run tests → All green? → Deploy to staging → Approved? → Deploy to production → Released. Loop: Code review → Build → Run tests → All green? → Deploy to staging → Approved? → Code review. Bottleneck: Approved?; without it the diagram falls apart. Commit pushed (start) in Development: leads to Code review. Code review in Development: leads to Build (merged). Build in Continuous integration: leads to Run tests. Run tests in Continuous integration: leads to All green?. All green? (decision) in Continuous integration: leads to Deploy to staging (yes) and Fix failures (no). Fix failures in Development: leads to Build (retry). Deploy to staging in Operations: leads to Approved?. Approved? (decision) in Operations: leads to Deploy to production (yes) and Code review (changes requested). Deploy to production in Operations: leads to Released. Released (end) in Operations: no further step. Group "Quality gates": Build, Run tests, All green?.

polyline.title: All green? → Deploy to staging: yes
